_comment: Single source of truth for site routes. App.tsx must declare exactly public + dynamic + internal + redirects (the build fails otherwise, see scripts/prerender-blog.mjs). The backend reads the built copy (static/routes.json) to decide what is a real 404. Paths have no leading slash; '' is the homepage. static_only pages have no React route and are served as pure prerendered HTML. server_rendered pages have a React route but no prerender entry: the backend renders the document per request from the DB (services/*_page.py), like match pages.
